items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Willie's brother. You know who he was. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's what made the medicine shows so good.

ctx.x: Willie's brother. You know who he was. A trombone player. He told me a similar story. I forget the medicine show that he was with. But he left town with a medicine show, and never did come back until the Seventies, when he came back to New Orleans. So in other words, you'd play for one hour. Well, you wouldn't play, but I mean, you'd entertain, like with the whole thing.
Yeah, that's what made the medicine shows so good. You play for one hour and you're through.
